{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crown of Dubrillion''' was a traditional symbolic form of headgear that was worn by the monarch of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]]. When King [[Arak Drayen III]] was overthrown and killed in [[3749 BBY]], he manage to take the crown with him and pass it to his [[Nok Drayen's father|son]]. His grandson [[Nok Drayen]] hid the crown on a ship within [[The Long Shadow]] until the day his family could retake the trone. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Risha Drayen]], the granddaughter of Arak, assembled the means to reach the Long Shadow and sent a smuggler known as the [[Voidhound]] to retrieve the crown. Nok himself eventually succumbed to a disease, but Risha kept planning to use the crown to retake the throne of Dubrillion from the current king [[Actavarus III]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Crown of Dubrillion appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Smuggler mission.
